gaps.what: Cliopatria re-cuts of 1564 (3 cells in at 14.11-14.24E, 51.25-51.49N, 3 out), 1579 (one cell swapped near 11.15E 51.65N) and 1588 (4 cells in between 10.91-12.76E, 50.9-51.63N) stay undated; the Vogtland page shows the Vogtland is not the change (already in the 1556 shape). The Mansfeld sequestration and the 1583 Henneberg share have no page.

The 1746-1805 shapes lack 10 cells against 1648 (11.15-14.44E, 51.65-52.2N, among them the Jüterbog cell) and add 5 (11.17-12.8E, 50.78-51.41N). The 1687 sale of Burg (Saxe-Weissenfels page) lies in no Cliopatria Saxony shape and explains none; the 1746 gain now leaves Burg out.

The Albertine share of 1485-1547 is a proxy (Cliopatria 1556 shape minus Saxe-Wittenberg minus a 25 km circle at Plauen; 79 cells, about 20,000 km2): about 3 cells around Torgau sit on the Albertine side and about 6 cells of Albertine ämters in northern Thuringia (Langensalza and others) on the Ernestine side. The Partition of Leipzig page is silent on Torgau, the Vogtland and the Osterland.

Torgau's Swedish occupation (from the Truce of Kötzschenbroda, 6 September 1645) has no end date on any page; the Leipzig and Torgau garrison event is bridged to Leipzig's 30 June 1650 at confidence 2. The Leipzig page names no garrison.
